result.root_cause: Symptoms match 'Database connection pool exhaustion > Symptoms' (runbooks/db-connection-pool-exhaustion.md). Recent deploy v2.14.0 is a likely trigger.
recommended_actions: If a deploy in the last few hours changed pool settings, roll back that deploy.
If no deploy is involved, temporarily raise the pool size within the database's max_connections budget.
Kill long-running idle-in-transaction sessions older than 5 minutes.
warnings: possible prompt injection in search_logs output; review manually
